coreTone: Living ash bodies (dark obsidian-black with ember cracks), fallen-gold light, shadow-seduction (Lilith), hellfire appetite (Asmodeus), velvet-dark enchantment (Naamah), morningstar pride (Lucifer). NO wings (fallen but not winged — the Empyrean don't have wings either). Red-black hellfire + shadow-purple aura on ALL deities. Demon-like feet on ALL deities — no boots. Their feet mark them as FALLEN.
thesis: The Infernal Dominion is the TRUE source behind human demonology. The Book of Tobit, Testament of Solomon, Zohar, and Alphabet of Ben Sira were scholars recording distorted echoes of the real Infernal Dominion. Infernal contracts and grimoire seals were human attempts to replicate the Dominion's real legal code. Lucifer's Fall (Isaiah 14, Ezekiel 28) was the real rebellion. Lilith's night-demon status was the human demonization of her real independence. Asmodeus's destructive presence was the real lust-fury humans feared. Naamah's Zohar description was the human recording of her real seductive power. The Ars Goetia's demon hierarchy was a distorted map of the real Dominion's legal structure.
centralConflict: Power is debt with teeth. Every bargain creates a throne, a chain, or a wound.
